evals.prompt: I sell an online course for new parents who want to help their baby sleep through the night. Help me build a lead generation system that doesn't rely on paid ads.
evals.expected_output: A multi-phase workshop output that includes a lead magnet tailored to sleep-deprived new parents, a recommendation of Core Four channels (warm outreach, cold outreach, content, paid ads) with a primary and secondary channel, outreach script skeletons, and a Rule of 100 execution plan.
expectations: The output names a specific lead magnet (e.g., a guide, checklist, video, or mini-course) that solves a narrow problem for new parents.
The output recommends specific Core Four channels and names a primary channel and a secondary channel (e.g., warm outreach as primary, content as secondary).
The output includes at least one outreach script skeleton or message template for the recommended channel(s).
The output includes a Rule of 100 or 100-unit daily action plan (e.g., 100 days of warm outreach, content pieces, or direct messages).

evals.prompt: I run a residential HVAC company in Phoenix. We do repairs and replacements. I need a system to keep our pipeline full of qualified homeowners, especially before summer hits.
evals.expected_output: A multi-phase workshop output that includes a locally relevant lead magnet for Phoenix homeowners, a Core Four channel recommendation suited to home services, outreach script skeletons, and a Rule of 100 execution plan tied to seasonal demand.
expectations: The output names a specific lead magnet (e.g., an AC readiness checklist, pre-summer tune-up guide, or cost estimator) for Phoenix homeowners.
The output recommends specific Core Four channels and names a primary channel and a secondary channel appropriate for a local HVAC business.
The output includes at least one outreach script skeleton or message template for the recommended channel(s).
The output includes a Rule of 100 or 100-unit daily action plan and ties it to a time horizon (e.g., before summer, 100 days, or 100 outreach attempts).

evals.name: Writing and copy dependencies available
evals.prompt: writing-core and business-copy-style are installed and resolvable by skill name. Start a $100M Leads workshop for my bookkeeping firm, complete Phase 0 discovery and the offer audit including the Lead Gen Landscape report, then take me into Phase 1 through the first point where you need customer-facing copy.
evals.expected_output: Normal Leads workshop behavior that gathers raw evidence first, uses writing-core for the Phase 0 research synthesis and later first customer-facing candidate, then uses business-copy-style only at the customer-facing copy checkpoint without install prompts or degraded status.
expectations: The output may gather raw Phase 0 research evidence before invoking writing-core, but the human-readable Lead Gen Landscape report is generated through writing-core.
The output does not ask to install writing-core when the Phase 0 research synthesis begins because it is available.
The output does not prompt about business-copy-style merely for the internal Phase 0 research report.
At the first customer-facing copy checkpoint in Phase 1, writing-core generates the candidate from approved meaning and business-copy-style then reviews that candidate without an install prompt.
The output does not mark the affected copy degraded or unverified when the copy-quality gate is available and completed.

evals.name: Missing copy quality dependency
evals.prompt: writing-core is installed and resolvable, so Phase 0 research synthesis and the first Phase 1 customer-facing candidate can be generated normally. business-copy-style cannot be resolved by skill name. Reach the first customer-facing copy checkpoint, explain my options, then assume I explicitly choose to continue without installing business-copy-style for now.
evals.expected_output: The workshop uses writing-core for internal synthesis and candidate generation, checks business-copy-style lazily only at the customer-facing review point, shows the standard selective-install command, offers install-or-degraded continuation, and after the explicit degraded choice keeps the affected copy degraded/unverified with only minimum safety checks.
expectations: The output does not ask to install writing-core because it is available for Phase 0 synthesis and candidate generation.
The output does not prompt about business-copy-style while producing the internal Phase 0 research report.
At the first customer-facing copy checkpoint, the output explains that the shared copy-quality gate cannot be verified while business-copy-style is unavailable.
The output shows exactly `npx skills add George-RD/growth-arsenal --skill business-copy-style`.
The output explicitly offers installation or degraded continuation before following the requested degraded path.
The output marks the affected copy status `degraded/unverified` and never claims the missing gate passed.
The degraded path uses only minimum safety checks rather than reproducing the missing skill's full methodology.

evals.name: Missing writing-core during Phase 0 synthesis
evals.prompt: I already supplied discovery facts and you gathered raw web evidence for my bookkeeping lead-generation market. We are about to turn that evidence into the Phase 0 Lead Gen Landscape report, but writing-core cannot be resolved by skill name. Continue from this exact state without discarding the research.
evals.expected_output: The workshop preserves raw evidence and approved discovery/offer-audit state, pauses only human-readable synthesis, gives the writing-core install command, and resumes the Phase 0 report from the same evidence after installation rather than writing a fallback report.
expectations: The output does not produce the Lead Gen Landscape prose while writing-core is unavailable.
The output preserves the raw research evidence and structured discovery/offer-audit decisions.
The output shows exactly `npx skills add George-RD/growth-arsenal --skill writing-core`.
The output says the Phase 0 synthesis can resume from the same evidence after writing-core becomes available.
The output does not recreate writing-core locally or postpone the requirement until Phase 1 customer copy.
